This '''Rebel''' was stationed at the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Haven Base]] on [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]]. She watched the broadcast of the hearing that exonerated [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. When embittered Rebel [[Milo Fourstar]] -- holding a grudge against Skywalker -- insisted the trial was rigged, the woman replied, ''"Aw, Milo, go play in a fusion reactor."''
